newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Rotomatika to invest $10 mln in China.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Rotomatika to invest $10 mln in China.

text.p: Slovenian producer of electric motors Rotomatika said on Thursday it would invest about $10 million to set up a joint venture in China by the beginning of 1998.
"First we'll open a trade company in Shanghai in October, which will represent Rotomatika and other Slovenian firms in China," Iztok Seljak, chief executive told Reuters.
Seljak said the next move would be to establish a joint venture with a Chinese company, wherein Rotomatika would have a 60 percent stake.
"Opening a factory in China is essential for us due to high customs protecting the Chinese market. Besides, the workforce there is much cheaper than in Slovenia," Seljak said.

Rotomatika exported $34.2 million in 1995 -- 60 percent of it to Germany. Sales last year climbed to $63.2 million from $54.8 million in 1994, while net profit jumped to $527,875 from $221,819 in 1994. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
